upstream.note: Clamor exposes this block as a read-only plan; it has no safe apply interface yet. This repository materializes the block's claims by hand from the inspected definition and its declared configuration, and treats Clamor as plan-only, never as an applied write.

digestVerification.method: Loaded the upstream BlockDefinition and computed definitionRef() with Clamor's own kernel (packages/kernel/src/definition.ts, digest.ts) against the checked-out upstream commit.

deviationsFromBlock: This project's package.json also declares oxlint, oxfmt, and a pinned stable typescript version, which the ConventionalCommits block references only as tool binaries (node_modules/.bin/oxfmt, node_modules/.bin/oxlint) without pinning their versions itself. Those extra devDependencies are this project's own choice, not part of the block's claims.

allowedTypes extends the block's default eleven standard config-conventional types with this project's research, design, governance, and plans types, matching design spec 0005's required allowed-type list.

conformance.method: Recomputes the sha256 digest of each exclusive_path claim's checked-in content and re-reads each semantic_key claim from package.json, then compares both against this file. A local edit to any materialized artifact, or an upstream re-render that would change the recorded digests, fails the check with the exact claim and digest that drifted.
